deals.evidence: En mai 2016, le RC Lens avait officialisé sa reprise par Solferino, à hauteur de 65% du capital
deals.headline: Solferino takes over RC Lens from Hafiz Mammadov, with Atlético Madrid
deals.summary: Luxembourg company Solferino, led by Joseph Oughourlian, took over RC Lens in May 2016 with 65% of the capital, alongside Atlético Madrid with 35%, ending the era of Azerbaijani businessman Hafiz Mammadov, who had held 99.9% since 2013.

deals.headline: Atlético Madrid takes 35% of RC Lens alongside Solferino
deals.summary: Atlético Madrid joined Solferino in the May 2016 takeover with 35% of the capital.

deals.evidence: des 34,6% du capital du Racing Club de Lens détenus par Atlético Madrid
deals.headline: Solferino buys Atlético Madrid's 34.6% of RC Lens
deals.summary: RC Lens announced that majority shareholder Solferino would take over the 34.6% held by Atlético Madrid, its entire stake, subject to authorisation by the Paris commercial court.

deals.evidence: SIDE INVEST va engager 20 millions d’euros dans le club présidé par Joseph Oughourlian
deals.headline: Side Invest invests EUR 20m in RC Lens for just under 13%
deals.summary: Side Invest, a regional public-private investment company (Région Hauts-de-France, the Mulliez family association AFM and IRD), committed EUR 20m for just under 13% of RC Lens; Joseph Oughourlian put the post-money valuation at EUR 155m. Side Invest holds 13.56% in 2026.

deals.evidence: la signature d’un contrat de crédit à terme d’un montant total de 50 M€ auprès de Goldman Sachs
deals.headline: EUR 50m Goldman Sachs term loan to Oughourlian's holding to fund the stadium purchase
deals.summary: According to the accounts of Coron, Joseph Oughourlian's Luxembourg holding company, the financing of the club's purchase of Stade Bollaert-Delelis was secured at the end of 2024 with a term loan of EUR 50m in total from Goldman Sachs. The borrower is the owner's holding, not the club.

deals.evidence: Le président du RC Lens avait également recapitalisé son club à hauteur de près de 11 M€ en décembre 2024
deals.headline: Owner recapitalises RC Lens by nearly EUR 11m
deals.summary: CFNEWS reports that Joseph Oughourlian recapitalised the club by nearly EUR 11m in December 2024 (amount left null because the page gives it only as 'nearly').

deals.date_text: Approved by Lens municipal council on 21 May 2025
deals.evidence: le club a récemment déboursé 27 M€ pour acquérir son stade de foot, Bollaert-Delelis auprès de la ville de Lens
deals.headline: RC Lens buys Stade Bollaert-Delelis from the City of Lens for EUR 27m
deals.summary: The club paid EUR 27m to acquire its stadium, Bollaert-Delelis, from the City of Lens; the sale was approved by the municipal council on 21 May 2025.

deals.evidence: repose sur une valorisation du club artésien fixée à 155 millions d’euros d’après une information de L’Équipe
deals.headline: Entrepreneur Equity Partners takes 13.93% of RC Lens
deals.source_name: Sportune (citing L'Équipe); RC Lens communiqué 31 August 2026
deals.summary: US sports-infrastructure fund EEP (represented on the board by Tim Leiweke) subscribed to a capital increase for 13.93%; the club says the whole equity contribution funds works around Stade Bollaert-Delelis. Together with Jean-Paul Lempereur's 2.79%, the raise is put at nearly EUR 30m by Oughourlian; L'Équipe reported a EUR 155m valuation (per Sportune). EEP's own cheque is not stated.

deals.evidence: is acquiring a 2.79% stake in the club (through a personal estate investment vehicle)
deals.headline: Jean-Paul Lempereur takes 2.79% of RC Lens
deals.summary: The founder of Groupe Lempereur, a board member since 2025, took 2.79% through a personal estate investment vehicle in the same capital increase as EEP.

name: Racing Club de Lens
notes: Revenue is DNCG's total non-transfer earnings for the club's consolidated perimeter in 2024-25 (EUR 68,780k); the SAS's own statutory turnover for the year to June 2025 is EUR 65.5m (French register; also quoted by CFNEWS). 2025-26 accounts not yet published. Breakdown uses DNCG categories (gate receipts as matchday, sponsors-advertising as commercial). Valuation is a transaction valuation, not a Forbes figure (Lens is not on the Forbes list): CFNEWS calls the EUR 155m pre-money and comparable to 2023, when Oughourlian called EUR 155m post-money. EEP's and Lempereur's individual cheques are not stated (Sportune derives ~EUR 21.6m and ~EUR 4.3m from the reported valuation; not used). The Goldman Sachs loan was taken by the owner's holding (Coron), not the club. Oughourlian has been club president since 2017 (club page). Lens finished 2nd in Ligue 1 2025-26 and won the 2026 Coupe de France and the 2026-27 Trophée des Champions (club palmarès page). No dated social-media follower count found.

ownership_summary: Joseph Oughourlian, founder of Amber Capital, has controlled RC Lens since May 2016 (through Solferino, first with Atlético Madrid at 65/35, alone after buying Atlético's 34.6% in December 2017) and held 69.10% after the August 2026 capital increase. Minority holders: US sports-infrastructure fund Entrepreneur Equity Partners 13.93% (2026), Side Invest 13.56% (regional public-private vehicle managed by IRD Invest, backed by the Région Hauts-de-France and the Mulliez family association; invested EUR 20m in 2023), Jean-Paul Lempereur 2.79% (2026, personal holding) and former player Seko Fofana 0.62%.
